name: rng
expr: rng(42); y = rand(); rng(42); z = rand(); r1 = double(y == z);
comment: Sig: rng(SEED). Side-effect smoke: same seed must produce same first sample (r1 = 1 in any deterministic PRNG). DEFERRED -- direct sample value parity not possible (numkit vs MATLAB use different PRNG algorithms; MT-19937 not bit-replicated).
